summary: Frontend testing of Government Landing Page and Experience Taxxa Demo page complete. All 11 features tested successfully. The landing page displays government-focused messaging with statistics, benefits, and case studies (Taiwan, Brazil, Portugal, Slovakia). The Experience page includes interactive phone mockup and fully functional scanner demo modal.

frontend: Government landing page loads at root URL (/)
Government landing page shows 'For Governments' branding badge
Government Solutions badge visible in hero section
Hero title 'Transform Tax Compliance Through Citizen Engagement' displayed
Key benefits section visible with 4 cards: Increase Tax Revenue (22%), Engage Citizens (2.5M+), Build Trust (99.99%), Real-Time Data (<50ms)
Case studies section displays all 4 countries: Taiwan (75% increase, since 1951), Brazil (22% increase, since 2007), Portugal (15% increase, since 2014), Slovakia (€30M, since 2013)
Experience page shows interactive phone mockup with feature tabs (Scan Receipts, My Tickets, Prize Draws, Leaderboard)
'Try Live Scanner' button opens scanner demo modal
Scanner demo modal shows sample receipts from Tanzania (TZS 125,000) and Kenya (KES 8,500)
'Scan This Receipt' starts scanner simulation with phases: Scanning → Verifying → Result with ticket number and entries
'Back to Home' button navigates from /experience back to landing page (/)
'Request Demo' button opens contact modal with form fields: Full Name, Government Organization, Official Email, Country, Requirements textarea

experience.tsx: Interactive demo page with phone mockup preview, feature tabs that update phone screen content, fully simulated scanner demo with phases (select → scanning → verifying → result), sample QR codes for Tanzania and Kenya
Both pages maintain consistent branding (Taxxa + purple/blue gradient theme)
Scanner demo is MOCKED client-side - no real API calls to tax authorities
